error.no_server_step: Check that IconShuffle is still running, then reload this page.
error.no_usb_device.title: No iPhone found over USB
error.no_usb_device.steps: Plug the iPhone in with a cable that carries data.
Unlock it. If it asks, tap Trust This Computer and enter the passcode.
error.usbmuxd_unreachable.darwin.title: The iPhone connection service did not answer
error.usbmuxd_unreachable.darwin.steps: macOS runs it itself: unplug the iPhone, plug it in again and try again.
If it keeps failing, restart the Mac.
error.usbmuxd_unreachable.win32.title: Apple Devices is not installed
error.usbmuxd_unreachable.win32.steps: Install Apple Devices from the Microsoft Store (iTunes works too): it brings the service that talks to the iPhone.
Plug the iPhone in again, then try again.
error.usbmuxd_unreachable.linux.title: usbmuxd is not running
error.usbmuxd_unreachable.linux.steps: Install usbmuxd from your distribution and start it: `sudo systemctl start usbmuxd`.
Plug the iPhone in again, then try again.
error.no_device.title: No iPhone found
error.no_device.steps: Plug the iPhone in with a cable that carries data and unlock it.
Over Wi-Fi it has to be awake, unlocked and on the same network, and it must have been connected with a cable and set up for Wi-Fi once.
error.not_trusted.title: This computer is not trusted yet
error.not_trusted.steps: Connect the iPhone with a cable and unlock it.
Tap Trust This Computer and enter the passcode.
error.trust_pending.title: Waiting for Trust This Computer
error.trust_pending.steps: Look at the iPhone: tap Trust and enter the passcode.
error.trust_denied.title: The iPhone did not trust this computer
error.trust_denied.steps: Unplug and plug the iPhone in again.
Tap Trust this time and enter the passcode, then try again.
error.locked.title: The iPhone is locked
error.locked.steps: Unlock the iPhone and keep it unlocked while you work.
error.not_paired.title: The iPhone did not accept this computer
error.not_paired.steps: Connect the iPhone with a cable and unlock it.
Tap Trust This Computer and enter the passcode.
error.no_pair_record.title: This computer is not paired with the iPhone for Wi-Fi
error.no_pair_record.steps: Connect the iPhone with a cable once and run `ios-homescreen wifi setup`.
error.stale_pair_record.title: The Wi-Fi pairing needs to be made again
error.stale_pair_record.steps: Connect the iPhone with a cable once and run `ios-homescreen wifi setup`.
error.not_advertising.title: The iPhone did not answer on the network
error.not_advertising.steps: Keep the iPhone awake and unlocked, on the same network as this computer.
Guest networks and client isolation keep the phone and the computer apart, and firewalls must let mDNS (UDP 5353) through.
Check with `ios-homescreen wifi status` over USB, or use the cable.
error.several_devices.title: More than one iPhone answered
error.several_devices.steps: Restart the editor with `--udid UDID` to pick one.
error.several_pair_records.title: More than one paired iPhone
error.several_pair_records.steps: Restart the editor with `--udid UDID` to pick one.
error.timeout.title: The iPhone did not answer in time
error.timeout.steps: Unlock the iPhone and keep it awake.
If it shows Trust This Computer, tap Trust.
error.connection_failed.title: Could not connect to the iPhone
error.connection_failed.steps: Unlock the iPhone and check the cable or the network.
error.restart.darwin: If every attempt times out, unplug the iPhone and plug it in again.
error.restart.win32: If every attempt times out, restart Apple Mobile Device Service (in Services), then reconnect the phone.
error.restart.linux: If every attempt times out, restart usbmuxd: `sudo systemctl restart usbmuxd`, then reconnect the phone.
error.layout_changed.title: The home screen changed on the iPhone
error.layout_changed.steps: Someone moved things on the phone after the last read, so nothing was written.
Read from phone again (your edits here are lost), or apply anyway to overwrite the phone's current layout.
error.showcase.title: Showcase mode does not write
error.showcase.steps: Start the editor without --showcase to change the phone.
error.unsafe_payload.title: The layout was refused before sending
error.unsafe_payload.steps: Nothing was written. Please report this as a bug, with the details below.
error.cancelled.title: Stopped
error.cancelled.steps: The server stopped before the operation finished.
error.generic.layout.title: The layout has problems
error.generic.layout.steps: Check the details below and try again.
error.generic.state.title: The file or layout cannot be used
error.generic.state.steps: Check the details below and try again.
error.generic.device.title: The iPhone operation failed
error.generic.device.steps: Check the details below and try again.
error.generic.other.title: Something went wrong
error.generic.other.steps: Check the details below and try again.
